summary_md: **s0ulmachine ([@s0ulmachine](https://x.com/s0ulmachine/status/2115614346420396538))** posts a detailed **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 4x RTX PRO 6000 (TP4)** throughput benchmark: vLLM fork container (ghcr.io/local-inference-lab/vllm), FP8 weights and KV cache, speculative decoding with 7 draft tokens, measured with sglang.bench_serving; the post corrects an earlier MXFP4 claim against the engine log.
relevance: A fully specified, reproducible serving config for a frontier open MoE on workstation GPUs.
